title: Command
description: Command palette and searchable action lists: CommandPalette is the app-wide ⌘K / Ctrl+K “search or create” box (mounted once in the root layout, fed by pages with useRegisterCommands); CommandDialog is a controlled dialog with your own open state (useHotkey); Command is the inline list. Matching ignores case and Vietnamese marks.
when: Every app with more than a few pages: mount CommandPalette once in the root layout to jump to a place or record and start a create action from anywhere on ⌘K (L1).
A SearchPill or “Tìm hoặc tạo” button in the header that opens CommandPalette (openCommandPalette).
A palette with your own open state and no app-wide registry (CommandDialog) or a searchable action list inside a Popover (Command).

instead.need: Pick one value in a form
Filter the list on the page

a11y: The input is an ARIA combobox owning a listbox (aria-activedescendant), so focus stays in the input; groups are labelled by their heading, disabled items are aria-disabled; dialogs trap focus, Escape closes and focus returns.

examples.title: App-wide palette (CommandPalette)
examples.description: Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K) or the button; type “tieu” to find the supplier by keyword.

examples.title: Controlled dialog (CommandDialog)
examples.description: Press ⌘J (Ctrl+J) or the button; try typing “don hang” without marks.

notes: A record that opens in a DetailOverlay on the current route: its `onSelect` calls `openDetail(id)` (or the page's `open(id)`), not `router.push("?open=…")` to the same route, which browsers without the Navigation API do not report to the list. Give it `href` too, for ⌘↵.
⌘K on Apple devices, Ctrl+K elsewhere (Ctrl+K on a Mac deletes to the end of the line in text fields); a key a widget already handled, or typed in a rich-text editor, does not open it.
